title: 都市的孤独
text:
今天，走在繁华的商业街头，四周人潮汹涌。每个人都低头凝视手机屏幕，沉浸在虚拟世界里。尽管物理距离极近，心理隔阂却深不可测。这种状态揭示了现代都市生活中普遍存在的疏离感。
高密度的居住环境并未带来情感的升温。相反，钢筋混凝土构建的墙壁将个体彻底孤立。人们在职场中扮演着高效的零件，失去了真实的人格交流。社交软件虽然扩大了联系范围，但缺乏深层共鸣。这种浅层互动无法填补内心的空虚。
过度追求效率导致了人际关系的工具化。人们倾向于通过利益衡量对方的价值，而非关注精神需求。当情感被量化，真诚便成了稀缺资源。许多年轻人面临着严重的心理危机，感到被社会边缘化。
这种异化现象并非偶然，而是工业文明的产物。快节奏的生活挤压了人们感知生活的时间。我们习惯于快餐式的社交，厌恶冗长的沟通。结果是，个体在喧嚣中陷入极端的寂寞。
我们需要反思当前的生存状态。重建真实的连接应当成为当务之急。这意味着要走出数字舒适区，尝试面对面的深度对话。关注邻里的细微变化，找回丢失的社区温情。
只有打破这种无形的屏障，才能缓解精神焦虑。城市不应只是经济活动的集散地，更应是温暖的栖息之所。重新定义社交质量，让生活回归人性。这需要每个公民共同努力。

questions.prompt: According to the text, despite people being physically close on the crowded street, what exists between them?
options: A shared sense of purpose
An unfathomably deep psychological gulf
Growing physical distance
A newfound spirit of cooperation

questions.prompt: According to the text, what effect did high-density housing have on emotional connection between neighbors?
options: It strengthened community bonds significantly
It had no measurable effect either way
It failed to bring emotional warmth, and reinforced-concrete walls isolated individuals instead
It only affected wealthy neighborhoods

questions.prompt: What metaphor does the text use to describe how people function in the workplace?
options: Independent artists expressing creativity
Loyal soldiers defending a cause
Efficient machine parts, losing real personal interaction
Wise mentors guiding younger colleagues

questions.prompt: According to the text, what is the main shortcoming of social apps, despite expanding people's range of contacts?
options: They are too expensive for most users
They lack deep emotional resonance, leaving shallow interactions
They only work well in rural areas
They require too much technical skill to use

questions.prompt: What solution does the text propose for overcoming urban alienation?
options: Building taller apartment complexes
Increasing state surveillance of public spaces
Stepping outside the digital comfort zone to have real face-to-face dialogue
Reducing the number of city residents

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 被 passive
patterns.explanation: Marks the passive voice: the subject is acted upon. 被 introduces the agent (optional) and is followed by the verb.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.
